description.en: Configure Space as global leader key.

hints: Deve essere impostato prima di caricare i plugin
Il localleader è per override specifici

description.it: Crea keymap per navigare tra finestre e buffer.
description.en: Create keymaps to navigate between windows and buffers.

hints: Ctrl-w è il prefisso per finestre
exercises.solution:
vim.keymap.set('n', '<C-h>', '<C-w>h', { desc = 'Go left' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<C-j>', '<C-w>j', { desc = 'Go down' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<C-k>', '<C-w>k', { desc = 'Go up' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<C-l>', '<C-w>l', { desc = 'Go right' })

description.it: Aggiungi keymap per creare e gestire split.
description.en: Add keymaps to create and manage splits.

hints: resize cambia altezza, vertical resize cambia larghezza
exercises.solution:
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>sv', '<cmd>vsplit<cr>', { desc = 'Vertical split' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>sh', '<cmd>split<cr>', { desc = 'Horizontal split' })
vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>sc', '<cmd>close<cr>', { desc = 'Close window' })
